card.name: The word working as a modifier
card.fires_on: The word "working" (sometimes "work" or "staff") used as a modifier before a noun, after "the" or "normal". It appears before nouns such as procedures, surface, population, class, group and memory.

modes.label: Working before a noun
modes.description: "Working" modifies a following noun in lab, handling or group phrases.
modes.example: Follow the normal<< working>> procedures for the handling of radiopharm

modes.label: Working population or class
modes.description: "Working" describes people who work, in political or economic text.
modes.example: ised by the ordinary<< working>> population, Thatcher declared war on the British

modes.label: Staff or work as modifier
modes.description: "Staff" or "work" used in the same modifying slot.
modes.example: The<< staff>> network is only available in the staff offices

card.plain: It marks the word "working" when it is describing a noun that comes next, such as working surface or working population.
